title: Tow Tariff for Trade-In Agreements Vehicles
content:
**Tariff.** On a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement, the towing deduction is the grade's towing fee plus the standard per-mile tow rate for every mile of the one-way tow distance beyond the standard included tow miles, the one-way tow distance being the distance recorded on the delivery appointment of the purchase the trade is applied to; it is rounded to the nearest cent.

| Tariff element | Figure |
|---|---|
| Towing fee | The grade's towing fee |
| Standard included tow miles | 25 miles |
| Standard per-mile tow rate | $2.00 per mile beyond the included miles |
| One-way tow distance | The distance recorded on the delivery appointment of the purchase the trade is applied to; where that purchase has no delivery appointment, no distance is recorded and no mile is charged |

## Worked examples (hypothetical towing fee of $120.00)

| One-way tow distance | Miles beyond 25 | Mileage charge | Towing deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 miles | 15 | $30.00 | $150.00 |
| 25 miles | 0 | $0.00 | $120.00 |
| 18 miles | 0 (never fewer than none) | $0.00 | $120.00 |
| 72 miles | 47 | $94.00 | $214.00 |
